description: Source code defining the MaskedTensor class and related functions for handling masked tensors in PyTorch, including type checks, tensor comparisons, string representations, and custom tensor subclassing.

classes.name: MaskedTensor
classes.description: A custom subclass of torch.Tensor that supports masking functionality, including data and mask management, sparse tensor support, and custom dispatching.

methods.name: is_masked_tensor
methods.description: Checks if an object is an instance of MaskedTensor.

methods.name: _masks_match
methods.description: Checks if two MaskedTensors have matching masks.

methods.name: _map_mt_args_kwargs
methods.description: Recursively maps arguments and keyword arguments, applying a function to MaskedTensors.

methods.name: _wrap_result
methods.description: Wraps tensor results into MaskedTensor objects, handling lists and tuples.

methods.name: _get_data
